plugins.name: job-fetch
plugins.description: Fetch + ingest a job description past a proxy-blocked host (Claude Code web egress allowlist), via ATS public APIs and a remote-exec MCP (Composio) fallback. Auto-fires on job URLs via a UserPromptSubmit hook; ingest-and-acknowledge, no JD echoed back.

plugins.name: linkedin-networking
plugins.description: Compliant networking helper: find companies to research and Haas / MBA alumni to contact, build Sales Navigator + Alumni-tool searches to run manually, draft outreach (via the product-networking skill), and track contacts in a private Google Sheet. Never scrapes/reads/automates LinkedIn and never sends messages. Auto-fires on LinkedIn URLs / networking intent via a UserPromptSubmit hook.
